description: This file contains unit tests for the ScreenshotSize functionality in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing PNG size reading from base64 data and handling of invalid data.

classes.name: ScreenshotSizeTests
classes.description: Test suite for ScreenshotSize functionality related to PNG size reading

methods.name: `read PNG size returns dimensions`
methods.description: Test that PNG size reading correctly returns width and height for a valid PNG data.

methods.name: `read PNG size rejects non PNG data`
methods.description: Test that PNG size reading returns nil for invalid data.
